description: This Java class `ProvisioningCriteria` defines a JPA entity representing provisioning criteria within the Fineract system. It manages provisioning configuration data including a name, associated provisioning definitions, and mappings to loan products. The class includes methods for updating the entity based on JSON commands and provisioning data, and fits into the provisioning domain of the application.

classes.name: ProvisioningCriteria
classes.description: Represents provisioning criteria with associated definitions and loan product mappings, enabling configuration and updates within the provisioning domain.

methods.name: getCriteriaName
methods.description: Returns the name of the provisioning criteria.

methods.name: setCriteriaName
methods.description: Sets the name of the provisioning criteria.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates the provisioning criteria based on a JSON command and a list of loan products, tracking actual changes made.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates a provisioning criteria definition with provided data and related GL accounts.
